why_agent_cannot: accept the project's terms in your own name
what_human_must_do: Read and accept the project terms in your own name.
steps_from_source: Open www.hertzflow.xyz and connect a wallet on BNB Smart Chain. "HertzFlow never requests your private keys or seed phrase."
Hold USDT on BSC and some BNB: "Keep at least 0.01 BNB for gas fees at all times".

A referral code box appears once: "You can bind a code or skip; the prompt only shows once per address." A bound code takes 5% off Normal-mode open and close fees. Only use a code from someone you trust.
If you want, deposit USDT into a pool or vault for liquidity Merits, or make swaps in the app.
Check your total on the Merits page and your rank on the leaderboard.
